title: Derive one-sided P112 fitting rigidity from support spectra
head: c4f1e3ace88ecc69cd1ea959ecf4f2e0930d015e
body:
This states a one-sided joint-fitting corollary of Adam Gall's PR1098 support-spectrum certificate and supplies an independent deletion-rank check. For `N=R W` over Q and `B=U L` over F2, unit diagonals and the required off-diagonal zeros force **N=R R^T and B=U U^T**. Only the two column spaces are fixed; neither row space needs a restriction.

Each binary column selects one of 511 character supports. Its diagonal fitting equation requires its own rational root to be a coloop, meaning deletion lowers the support rank. PR1098's published spectra imply that the only such pairs are the 112 original character/port pairs. The checker establishes the same classification through exact row deletion and confirms the coordinate bridge to the predecessor geometry.

The support lemma belongs to Mihir Srivastava's PR845, and the spectra and sharp energy constant four belong to Adam Gall's PR1098. This contribution makes their one-sided joint-fitting corollary explicit and checks it by a separate method. It does not claim new underlying geometry.

## Verification

- The registered Python 3.12 replay passed, including metadata and source pins.
- The optimized Python 3.14 replay passed with the same deterministic transcript digest.
- Both cover 511 supports, 4,080 basis-row deletions, 4,591 positive integer Gram minors, the 112 unique coloop pairs, positive fixtures and nine rejected corruptions.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/polarized-p112-code-bound`.

Transcript SHA256: `ecd7a758baff7dc84b11dd238fe2bb9b09ad0d2761d5b68f6355132c67e38720`.

## Scope and credit

This is a written corollary with exact finite evidence. Outside-code factors, changed ports, block-valued replacements and complete paid supplier costs remain open. No new supplier, exponent, selected-frontier change or full Lean multiplication proof follows.

The package references unchanged icekylinx root/Hamming inputs and the PR845 reference geometry. It credits @adamgall's PR1098, @mihir-s-05's PR845, DreamingOfClouds' geometry, @mightyOil's related fixed-mask one-sided result in PR1191, and @Tuafo's separate fixed-mask theorem in PR1744. Prepared by Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0.

Coordination: [Discussion1803](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1803). The latest complete overlap refresh covered 493 open PRs and 478 Discussion records at 11:36–11:38 UTC; it found no matching explicit joint-fitting corollary. That metadata check does not establish literature-wide novelty.
